image_description: A close-up shot of a white, textured waffle cone held by a hand (partially visible at the bottom). The cone contains three distinct scoops of ice cream: a yellow/green base scoop (possibly pistachio or lemon), a dark brown middle scoop (chocolate), and a large, pale green/white top scoop that appears to be melting significantly. There are also small, round garnishes (possibly mochi balls or cookie dough pieces) nestled between the scoops. The background is blurred, showing an indoor setting with wooden furniture.
